keyword.en: how to read Diesel 40 Concrete Pump pumping distance
keyword.zh: 柴油40型混凝土泵输送距离怎么读

title.en: 120 m stays on the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump page
title.zh: 120 m仍写在柴油40型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印这一页

description.en: Diesel 40 Concrete Pump. 120 m stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Fluid dynamics.
description.zh: 柴油40型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印。120 m仍在目录格子里。插图来自「流體動力學」。

h1.en: 120 m stays on the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump page
h1.zh: 120 m仍写在柴油40型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印这一页

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Pumping Distance (H / V) is 120 m / 360 m. Read each label with its own figure. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_dynamics.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油40型混凝土泵的距离文字写成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是120 m / 360 m。同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_dynamics。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_dynamics. The image subject is Teardrop shape. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Pumping Distance (H / V) is 120 m / 360 m. The frame “Hose” shows Druckschlauch Schmutzwasserkreiselpumpe and does not replace these entries. The sheet already separates them when it lists both. Main-unit weight is 2800 kg. If a distance entry is missing on the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump sheet, it stays missing. Do not paste another manufacturer's boom length onto Diesel 40 Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_dynamics。画面内容是Teardrop shape。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油40型混凝土泵的距离文字写成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是120 m / 360 m。输送距离（水平/垂直）是120 m / 360 m。理论输送量是26 m³/h，最大出口压力是25 MPa。

body.en: Read each label with its own figure. Pumping Distance (H / V) is 120 m / 360 m. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. Subject: Druckschlauch Schmutzwasserkreiselpumpe. Theoretical Output is 26 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 25 MPa.
body.zh: 同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。管路沿程要克服摩擦，水平段和垂直升高不是同一项工作。

body.en: Horizontal and vertical are not interchangeable when both appear, and a missing vertical entry is not filled from another model. A pipeline loses pressure to friction, so a horizontal run and a vertical rise are different duties. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not read a metre figure off that frame. Neither entry is a metre.
body.zh: 画面「Hose」的主体是泵，不能代替这些格子。柴油40型混凝土泵这一页如果少了某一距离格，就让它继续空着。

question.en: Which distance text does Diesel 40 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 柴油40型混凝土泵标出了哪几句距离？

answer.en: Pumping Distance (H / V) is 120 m / 360 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_dynamics.
answer.zh: 输送距离（水平/垂直）是120 m / 360 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_dynamics画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can horizontal and vertical be swapped?
question.zh: 水平和垂直可以对调吗？

answer.en: Only when the label itself puts them in that order. Keep the shown order. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_dynamics.
answer.zh: 只有标题本身写成那个顺序时才按那个顺序。保留写出来的次序。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_dynamics画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 26 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_dynamics.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是26 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fluid_dynamics画面里印出的数字。
